items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: So Zutty Singleton was in the band with Sidney Desvignes and all of them.

ctx.x: How old were you when you bought your B-flat clarinet?

Oh, about 14 years old.
Now, this I have to tell you. You know, I had a friend, a good friend of mine, Big Eye Louie Nelson. He was a clarinet player. Usually people at clubs used to give picnics on Sundays out at Lake Pontchartrain and they'd hired him. And sometimes he'd be so tired he couldn't make it, so he'd get off and stop by the house and ask me to go and play in his place. So Zutty Singleton was in the band with Sidney Desvignes and all of them. And at the lake, you know, sometime the hall would be way…

says, 'Don't worry.' So we started playing some number and I was trying to jazz it up and I couldn't make them notes and the chord and I hit one note and I just held that note all the way, and Zutty said, 'Get off that damn note, get off. Cut that note off.' And I just held that note and I stopped that note so short. He hollered at me and I started almost to crying, and Willie put his arms around me. He said, 'Don't worry, son, I'll take care of you.' And every time I'd see Zutty we'd start laughing about that.…
